run_prepare_ade20k: run the prepare_ade20k_sem_seg script to process training and validation annotation directories
review_convert_function: review the convert function that shifts ADE20K annotation pixel values and saves the output image
summarize_ade20k_prep: summarize the prepare_ade20k_sem_seg script that batch converts ADE20K annotations for detectron2 compatibility
